project_type: Cloudflare Workers + D1 database (SQLite), Hono backend, React+Vite frontend, deployed as single Worker serving both API and static assets
build_system: npm workspaces with Wrangler 4.0 for Cloudflare deployment. Frontend builds to web/dist which is served by Worker via assets binding.
test_framework: Manual smoke tests in scripts/smoke-test.mjs. No automated test framework for this task - verification is manual via dev servers and browser testing.
build_command: npm run build:web (builds React app to web/dist)
test_command: npm run dev:api (starts local Cloudflare Worker at localhost:8787) and npm run dev:web (starts Vite dev server at localhost:5173 for faster frontend iteration)
verification_instructions: 1. Run database migration locally: npm run db:migrate:local. 2. Start API server: npm run dev:api. 3. In separate terminal, optionally start Vite dev server: npm run dev:web. 4. Open http://localhost:8787 (or :5173 for Vite). 5. Test setup flow with system owner checkbox. 6. Create multiple pharmacies and staff assignments. 7. Verify data isolation by logging in as different users. 8. Test pharmacy switcher and consolidated dashboard. 9. For production: npm run db:migrate:remote, then npm run deploy.
snapshot_or_generated_files: web/dist/* (entire build output from Vite) gets checked in and deployed. Generated by npm run build:web. Not strictly necessary for local dev (can use Vite server), but required for deployment.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell environment. Wrangler CLI must be available (installed via npm). D1 database uses --local flag for development (SQLite file in .wrangler). For production, requires wrangler login and database_id in wrangler.toml. JWT_SECRET must be set via wrangler secret put JWT_SECRET for production (or .dev.vars for local).
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Inferred requirements: Match existing code style (2-space indent, single quotes where possible, semicolons). Use existing lib.js helpers (q.all, q.first, q.run, nowUtc, money, str, int). Follow Hono routing patterns with middleware. Use existing UI components from web/src/ui.jsx. Maintain backward compatibility - existing single-pharmacy deployments must continue working.
key_patterns: Backend: Hono app with middleware pipeline, JWT auth via Authorization header, context.set('user') and context.get('user') for user access, q.all/q.first/q.run for database, audit() for audit log entries, HttpError and bad() for error responses, need() middleware factory for role checks. Frontend: React functional components with hooks, custom useLoad() hook for data fetching with loading/error states, useToast() for notifications, Modal/Field/Badge/PageHead reusable components from ui.jsx, api.js get/post/put functions with automatic token injection, getToken/setToken for localStorage persistence.
directory_structure: worker/ (backend code: src/ for routes and lib, migrations/ for D1 SQL migrations), web/ (frontend React app: src/ for components/pages/contexts, dist/ for build output), scripts/ (smoke-test.mjs for API testing), wrangler.toml (Cloudflare Worker config with D1 binding and assets binding)
